caption: The drawing features a rectangular section of ornamental textile or wallpaper with a rich color scheme predominantly in red and yellow. The background is red, while the decorative elements and borders are in yellow. The design includes large, stylized floral and leafy motifs, some with intricate detailing such as small dots and feather-like patterns. There are two distinct borders along the top and left edges consisting of repeated yellow shapes on the red background, resembling stylized teardrop or leaf forms. The central section is divided by a vertical yellow band containing more simplified floral shapes. The floral elements within the main sections are bold, with large petals and leaves curving and branching out across the red field. The composition appears symmetrical along the horizontal and vertical axes where the borders intersect. The name "P. Jenner" is written in small red letters in the lower right corner of the drawing. The entire design is centered on a plain white or off-white background.
title: Silk Kerchief
